content.title: Tar Pit
content.body:
A note I found, written by someone else in the past:

"That was quite a tussle, but well worth it.

I had been in one of the expansive caverns underground when I came across a pool of black, liquid tar, with some ruins around it.
It was the perfect place to find submerged loot!

Only when I approached it, the tar suddenly rose into the air and molded into a red-eyed beast before my eyes.
The creature exploded, and I was hurt severely.
It began to clamber towards me, and it was only with a few lucky arrow shots that I was able to destroy it.

I emptied the pool of tar and found pots solidified in tar at the bottom. One of them gave me shiny pink shards, and the other gave me a twisted dagger, which seemed to be imbued with magical power. The first real loot of the adventure."
